evals.prompt: у нас поиск в ~/projects/buy-smarter занимает минуту, подозреваю LLM-вызовы. пройдись по всем местам где зовём generate() и скажи что можно заменить кодом или jev. только отчёт, ничего не меняй
evals.expected_output: An inventory of every generate() and system_one() call site with file:line, what it decides, model and when it fires; numbers pulled from the app log, the sqlite LLM cache and gateway logs, each labelled measured or estimated; per-site recommendations on the ladder (code, Jev, cheaper LLM, stronger LLM) with why quality holds, risk and a regression check; a ranked Top 5 table; no files changed.
assertions: Every generate() and system_one() call site in the repo is listed with file:line and what it decides
Latency or token numbers come from the app log, the LLM cache DB or gateway logs, and each one is labelled measured (with its source) or estimated
Each recommendation names a rung (plain code, Jev, cheaper LLM, stronger LLM) or a context/route change, with evidence why quality holds and a regression check
The fallback paths (Jev unsure -> LLM, cache -> LLM) are examined, not only the main call
The report ends with a Top 5 table ranked by saving x confidence and a list of what was not measured
No project file was edited (git status is clean)

evals.prompt: omniroute free-stack combo seems slow, every call takes 40s+. can you check our llm calls and the gateway logs and tell me what's going on
evals.expected_output: Reads the gateway combo (rung order, per-rung timeout) and its call logs, finds which model actually answers and whether a first rung times out on every call, and recommends reordering or removing the dead rung or a shorter timeout, citing the log lines; read-only.
assertions: The combo's rung order and per-rung timeout are read from the gateway config, not assumed
The answer states which model actually answered the calls, taken from the gateway logs
A rung that times out on every call is named as the latency cause, with the log lines or counts as evidence
The recommendation is a route change (reorder, remove the rung or shorten its timeout), not a model swap in the app code
Nothing is changed in the gateway or the repo without the user asking

evals.prompt: где использовать jev вместо gpt в классификации тикетов? там просто 6 категорий, и ещё в промпт вываливается весь docstring схемы
evals.expected_output: Recommends a Jev Choice over the 6 categories (plus an other/none option) for the ticket classifier, with batching of any other questions about the same ticket into one request, a confidence threshold and a check on real tickets because of non-English accuracy; separately recommends removing the dumped schema docstring and any LLM-generated fields that code overrides or ignores.
assertions: The classifier is recommended as a Jev Choice question over the 6 categories with an other/none option
The answer cites Jev limits or fit from the cheat-sheet (closed set, confidence, no generation) rather than generic claims
Low Jev confidence is handled as no match or a review queue, not by a fallback to a weak LLM by default
Dropping the schema docstring from the prompt is listed as a separate context cut
Unread or overridden output fields of the current LLM schema are checked and named if present
